# 07 · Control for flight

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

The cascaded rate–attitude–velocity–position loops that fly a multicopter, how four commands become four motor outputs, why filtering decides how hard you can push the D term, and how to tune Hermon methodically instead of by feel.
